name: Zvučna Proba
description: Ti si tonac na probi za Kluboslavija. Slušaš snippet, dijagnostikuješ EQ problem jednim tapom, koriguj — pre nego što publika uđe. 10 rundi, boss probe, daily highscore, Avala CTA.

modules.src/main.js: Bootstrap, game loop, correction phase timer reset
modules.src/config.js: Konstante, runde tabela, scoring params, tolerance po rundi
modules.src/input.js: Touch + click unified input, 400ms touchFired guard
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio: carrier oscilatori, BiquadFilter lanac, SFX, snippet playback
modules.src/render.js: Canvas: VU meter 3 zone, 60fps realtime baš
modules.src/ui.js: DOM screens: start, HUD, dijagnoza, korekcija, rezultat, game-over, win
modules.src/systems/progression.js: Runda logika, Boss probe, isDouble flag
modules.src/content/brand_hooks.js: Avala countdown, CTA URLs, Kluboslavija branding
modules.styles/game.css: VU meter, timer bar, streak, animacije
